nodes.label: Player Correlations
nodes.rationale: Positive same-team assist-and-goal pairings and negative contested-role pairings are computed from existing roster profiles without new scraping or schema.

nodes.label: Auction Checklist and Phase Tracker
nodes.rationale: A guided checklist derives only computable signals from roster and budget data, while unavailable planned-price information is explicitly manual.

nodes.label: No New Scraper or Schema
nodes.rationale: Both features are read-only views over fields already present in ranked-role and roster outputs.

nodes.label: Role Percentile Comparison
nodes.rationale: Player metrics are made interpretable by comparing them with the distribution for the same role.

nodes.label: Rules-Based Player Verdict
nodes.rationale: The detail page closes with an explainable verdict derived from existing metrics rather than opaque prediction.

nodes.label: Tactical Profile Score
nodes.rationale: A bounded 0-100 role-Mantra baseline plus capped production bonus represents tactical attacking value without allowing extreme statistics to dominate.

nodes.label: Bounded Fantasy Value Adjustment
nodes.rationale: Only defenders and midfielders receive a centered, bounded adjustment because attacker threat is already captured by fantasy average and goals.

nodes.label: Modular Scraping Architecture
nodes.rationale: Source-specific scraper plugins feed normalization, player matching, SQLite persistence, ranking, and a multipage Streamlit dashboard.

nodes.label: Conservative Player-ID Matching
nodes.rationale: Low-confidence or ambiguous name-and-team matches are skipped to prevent metrics from being attached to the wrong player.

nodes.label: Optional Risk Inputs
nodes.rationale: Injury resistance and investment stability enrich risk only when available, preserving prior behavior for unscraped or unmatched players.

nodes.label: Price Engine
nodes.rationale: Fair price derives from score and role value-for-money median; maximum price adds bounded scarcity and replacement premiums.

nodes.label: Scarcity Score
nodes.rationale: Exponential decay makes the first missing comparable alternatives matter more than differences among already plentiful alternatives.

nodes.label: Decision Center
nodes.rationale: Affordable available candidates are grouped into explainable BUY, DIFFERENZIALE, ATTENDI, and EVITA buckets.

nodes.label: Readable Ideal Squad Pitch
nodes.rationale: The pitch moves from a small fixed overlay into normal full-width page flow with larger typography while preserving data logic.

nodes.label: Explicit Streamlit Navigation
nodes.rationale: st.navigation removes the placeholder app page and makes Monitoraggio the explicit default.

nodes.label: 1000-Auction Simulation
nodes.rationale: Repeated stochastic auctions validate budget, uniqueness, optimizer, tier, and spending-distribution invariants against the real player pool.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Tier Calibration
nodes.rationale: TOP and SEMI_TOP thresholds change only when real distributions and simulation output show clear imbalance.

nodes.label: Failure Isolation and Retry
nodes.rationale: Each job failure is isolated; unsuccessful attempts do not consume cadence and remain due for the next run.
